name: A Twelve-Concept Trapped Dismantlable-Ample Interval
statement: The 85-concept smaller section $Q\subseteq Q_{11}$ of the 291-concept obstruction contains a 73-concept family $B\in\mathsf{Damp}$ with $\operatorname{Cor}(Q)\subseteq B$. The upper family $Q$ is also dismantlable ample, $|Q\setminus B|=12$, and no ample family lies strictly between $B$ and $Q$. Therefore $\rho_{\mathsf{Damp}}\le12$.
proof: Start from the 59-concept overlap $K$ and adjoin the fourteen certified concepts one at a time. The exact colon test proves every intermediate ample, so reversing the additions after peeling $K$ proves $B\in\mathsf{Damp}$. The same source certificate proves $Q\in\mathsf{Damp}$ and places every corner of $Q$ already in $K\subseteq B$. The twelve remaining concepts acquire twelve distinct shattered supports. Exhausting all $2^{12}-2=4094$ proper nonempty subsets finds no ample intermediate, establishing both the interval gap and the threshold bound.
